piece.headline: SUKRUT SPRINGS CLEAR AS PARTH SLIPS
piece.big_picture: Sukrut and Parth were level. Now Sukrut is alone in 1st, 15 clear. He left 24 points on the bench. Parth played his Triple Captain, worth 5 extra, and still lost top spot. Aarin is 3rd.
piece.decision_of_the_week: Sukrut picked the wrong 11 and left 24 points on the bench. He still finished the week 15 clear of Parth.
piece.one_to_watch: Aditya Dalal and Anuj are one point apart on the Gold spots line. Next week could settle who sits on the right side.

winners.name: Atharva Kshirsagar
winners.verdict: Up 9, the week's biggest climb. Those 22 points on the bench sting, though.

winners.verdict: Joint Manager of the Week with 92 points. The Wildcard got a proper result.

losers.verdict: Cherki on the armband gave 2 points. Another 12 sat on the bench.
